doc.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leaving Hampton and joining Jimmie Lunceford
summary: He leaves Hampton without another job and Renauld Jones recommends him to Lunceford.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: When you left Lionel Hampton’s band, did you know what you were going to do next? Or did you just go? You said this was enough.

No, I just left. I felt – in a way, I did it – I left that way, because I didn’t think it would be right if I only left because I had something else to go to right away, because I was somewhat angry at the time I left. I just felt, I’ll just leave and take my chances with whatever else comes up. That’s what I did.
Did you go back to Philadelphia?
Yeah, but for a short time. Then I joined Jimmie Lunceford’s band. I joined Jimmie’s band there.

One of my friends was in the band, Renauld Jones, who later played with the Basie band – played with a lot of bands. Jonesy recommended me. Jimmie had heard of – he knew of me. So he said he’d like for me to play lead in the band, and he hired me.
